method: Separate reviewer session: Factory worker session 35c4494a-0629-401b-9a98-63dae38ec63e, started by calling session c7aafd01-98d8-490e-bb97-8c5975fd3497. The id was read from this session's script-log directory and confirmed against the session_start line of its session file. Step 1, blind solve: read only target/gold-review-stems.md, docs/contract.md, docs/taxonomy.md and docs/sources.json, solved all 8 MCQ and 8 vignette stems from subject knowledge, and wrote the answers with reasons to target/gold-blind-solutions.md (SHA-256 a0fce6d46ae5b996149bc486c661b4a43f9a14da9cef03b845b298d8384f3a36, written 2026-11-21T04:47:25Z) before opening any gold JSONL file, near-miss file, key, rationale or review table. The blind input was afterwards confirmed to contain every stem, option, presentation, finding and question of the 16 records. Step 2, comparison: read the 24 records and compared each key or expected answer with the blind answer. Step 3, passage check: fetched all 17 distinct cited OpenStax sections from openstax.org with FetchUrl on 2026-11-21 (UTC), HTTP 200 for each, located each section body under its heading, and checked every factual sentence of every stem, answer, reasoning step, teaching point, tutor response, distractor refutation and stated model limit against the section text. Each passage quoted in the evidence fields was string-matched against the fetched text, and each stated absence was confirmed by searching the section body. A claim passed if the cited section states it, or if it follows in one logical or arithmetic step from what the section states plus the record's own stipulations; invented patient observations and stipulated model values were treated as exempt under contract section 4. Step 4, tier and taxonomy: compared each tier with taxonomy section 4 for its format, and each domain/subdomain pair and source coverage with taxonomy section 3.2 and docs/sources.json. Step 5, near-misses: read the six probes together with their manifest (not blind), re-derived each correct answer from the stem and the cited passage, and looked for any defect other than the planted one. Structural check: all 30 records were checked inline against the keywords of schemas/*.v1.json, the domain/subdomain mapping, option-label and key rules, registry status and locator syntax, and duplicate JSON keys; no cargo command was run. Not done: no originality or contamination audit (no question bank or exam item was consulted), no dataset admission; verification_status was left at unverified and no record or code was edited. record_sha256 is the SHA-256 of each JSONL line's UTF-8 bytes without the line terminator, or of the whole file for near-miss probes. Outcome: 22 records pass every applicable check; gold-cv-preclinical-0001 (key_check, rationale_check) and gold-tut-preclinical-0002 (anchor_check) need the edits described in their failed checks and must be re-reviewed after editing; all six planted defects were confirmed with no second defect found.
